title: Picture-based assessment of subjective deficits in cognition and ADL (Pic-ADL)
summary:
The present project aims to develop a largely language-free, graphically designed screening questionnaire (Picture-based assessment of subjective deficits in cognition and ADL; Pic-ADL), which reliably and economically assesses subjectively experienced changes in cognition and activities of daily living even in the case of reduced linguistic and/or cognitive abilities. This is a self-assessment. It should improve the diagnosis and differentiation between age-associated cognitive changes vs. mild cognitive impairment vs. mild dementia.
In addition to the existing full-length version of the questionnaire, a short version and a digital version will be developed and evaluated.

interventions.name:
Healthy control group
One-time completion of questionnaires on mood, activities of daily living and subjective cognitive deficits & one-time performance of cognitive tests. After 14 days, the image-based questionnaire "Pic-ADL" should be completed again.

Patients with subjective cognitive impairment, mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia of various etiologies who are undergoing inpatient or outpatient treatment at the Clinic and Polyclinic for Neurology at Cologne University Hospital.
One-time completion of questionnaires on mood, activities

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Control group:
- Vision and hearing: unimpaired or sufficiently corrected (glasses, hearing aid, etc.)
- Sufficient knowledge of German
- Sufficient language skills (documented in the Aphasie-Check-Liste short version)
- Disease status: no known neurological diseases
- Cognitive status: no known impairments
- Consent: consented and signed

Clinical patients:
- Vision and hearing: unimpaired or sufficiently corrected (glasses, hearing aid, etc.)
- Sufficient knowledge of German
- Sufficient language skills (documented in the Aphasie-Check-Liste short version)
- Disease status: patients undergoing inpatient or outpatient treatment at the Clinic and Polyclinic for Neurology
- Cognitive status: patients with subjective cognitive impairment, mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia of various etiologies
- Consent: consented and signed
Exclusion criteria:
Control group:
- Vision and hearing: impaired (so that the instructions cannot be conveyed either audibly or visually)
- Limited knowledge of German
- Substantial language impairments (documented in the Aphasie-Check-Liste short version)
- Disease status: known neurological diseases
- Cognitive status: substantial impairments
- Consent: not consented, not signed

Clinical patients:
- Vision and hearing: impaired (so that instructions cannot be conveyed either audibly or visually)
- Limited knowledge of German
- Substantial language impairments (documented in the Aphasie-Check-Liste short version)
- Disease status: patients in whom neurological diseases have been reliably ruled out. Moderate or severe illnesses that interfere with the ability to complete the survey
- Cognitive status: neither subjective nor psychometrically verifiable cognitive impairment, patients with severe dementia (DemTect ≤ 6 points)
- Consent: not consented, not signed
